**Introducing Rowbase: Turn Any Spreadsheet into an API in Seconds**

Rowbase is now publicly available as of March 4, 2026. It turns your spreadsheets and data files into working REST APIs without servers, backend code or setup.

Rowbase grew out of a simple frustration. Too many teams have useful data stuck in files that their apps can't reach. With Rowbase, you upload a file and get a live, queryable endpoint right away. It supports five file formats, so whatever format your data is in, it can become an API.

Before launch, 212 beta users tested Rowbase on everything from internal dashboards to side projects and customer-facing prototypes. Their feedback shaped the product: faster setup, cleaner endpoints and fewer surprises.

You can start for free. The free tier includes 1,000 requests per day, which is plenty for prototyping, personal projects or a small production workload. When you need more, paid plans grow with you.

Thanks to every beta tester who helped get us here. We can't wait to see what you build.

Upload your first file today and turn your rows into an API with Rowbase.
